name: miniapp-python-fullstack
description: UniApp multi-platform client and FastAPI backend managed as a Trellis-ready monorepo.

scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --frozen ruff check .
scripts.format:api: cd apps/api && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --frozen ruff format .
scripts.check:api: cd apps/api && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --frozen python -m compileall -q app tests
scripts.check: pnpm run check:api && pnpm run check:miniapp
